title: Polynomially budgeted SAT with a supplied strong 2-CNF backdoor
claims: TwoSatBackdoorInP constructs a language in the exact reference P that solves encoded SAT when the input supplies a variable list with polynomially many assignments and deleting literals on that list leaves at most two literals per clause.
Any accepted well-formed input formula is satisfiable even without the budget and width promises. The proof runs the reference 2-SAT machine on each deterministically computed residual formula.
P_subset_NP is separately checked against the exact reference definitions.

experiments.purpose: Run the pinned reference checker where available. Otherwise compare source hashes with the submitted checker transcript, without awarding experimental Lean points.
